result.summary: The page is largely well-formed, but there are a few visual defects: truncated text on a horizontally scrolling card, a partially rendered empty category chip, and a bottom card that is cut off mid-image without visible metadata. Most are minor carousel/viewport clipping issues rather than fundamental breakage.

issues.description: The restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol' in the 'Fastest near you' carousel is hard-truncated at the screen edge with no ellipsis, making the name look broken rather than intentionally clipped.
issues.suggestion: Apply text truncation with an ellipsis (…) constrained to the card width, so partially visible cards don't show raw cut-off text.

issues.description: A category filter chip after 'Healthy' is partially visible at the right edge but shows no label, appearing as an empty gray pill fragment.
issues.suggestion: Ensure the chip label is at least partially visible or add a gradient fade/peek affordance at the edge to signal horizontal scrolling instead of showing an empty sliver.

issues.description: The bottom 'Popular right now' card (pizza with −20% badge) is clipped by the bottom navigation with no name, rating, or delivery info visible, which can look broken at initial load.
issues.suggestion: This is expected scroll behavior, but consider adding bottom padding or a fade so the card visibly reads as scrollable content rather than abruptly cut off behind the nav bar.

issues.description: The 'See all' links and green promo banner text use mid-tone green/white combinations that may have borderline contrast, and the search placeholder text is low-contrast gray.
issues.suggestion: Verify contrast ratios meet WCAG AA (4.5:1 for body text) for the 'See all' links, promo subtext, and placeholder text; darken colors if needed.
